result.title: Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation
result.summary: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于 score 扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，通过离线间接训练加在线数据同化，在缺少闭合项真值的情况下学习并校正降阶模型，并在二维湍流上验证其统计刻画与状态预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 闭合项可视为降阶模型中未观测的潜状态修正，其后验 score 同化与「非高斯不确定性下的状态更新」问题相近，其无需直接监督的间接学习也可能为 LVR 中潜推理状态的更新与监督提供可核查线索。
